text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Incredible lineup here!
Straight out of dream!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Each carrying weight of era on shoulders,
showdown between famous Uma Musume!
Now lined up——

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Uma Musume beloved by all,
Kitasan Black!
After first G1 victory at 『Kikka Sho』,
setting off fireworks in other races including
Spring and Autumn Tenno Sho!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Indomitable Noble Lady,
Gentildonna! Claiming Triple Tiara,
first to take consecutive victories at 『Japan
Cup』, forging own awe-inspiring path!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Pioneering new era,
captivating all who saw her run,
Vodka!
Breaking 64-year drought by winning 『Japan
Derby』 even in Tiara rotation!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Hear chorus of praise? T.M.
Opera O!
Undefeated record of 8 wins in 8 races,
earning title Centurial Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Each incredible Uma Musume who won 7 turf
G1 races,
tied for most in history! And then...
and then! Finally——!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
In Twinkle Series,
first in history undefeated Triple Crown
Uma Musume!
First Uma Musume in history to become 7-time
turf G1 Winner!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
That 『Strength』 in victory already part of
race history!
Path carved out truly Royal Road of racing
world!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Efforia. Wonder if that describes this.
Given such opportunity,
I can barely contain excitement.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Together we stand at summit.
I stand ready——

Everyone waiting. For change.
For one to overturn all.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Then heading out... Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah——Almond Eye. Go out there and win
Yeah——Almond Eye. Go out there and win

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Right. I will win. Over everyone.

Times will change. ——Not aspiration.
Undeniable fact.
All began——several years ago.
————Finally. ...Finally, finally!

Obtained trainer license for Central.
Becoming trainer at Tracen Academy!

To ensure firm foundation,
came looking for useful books.
Racing textbooks, nutrition,
anatomy——books starting to pile up.
choice_data_list: (I have to be as prepared as possible)
(I have to be as prepared as possible)

text_block_list.text:
——Sometimes Uma Musume called 『Existences
carrying aspirations of everyone』.

Sometimes dramatic comeback.
Or graceless unconventional race throwing
everything out window.

Wish turns into run,
might even turn into salvation.
That is why——
choice_data_list: (I want to be the one to support them)
(I want to be the one to support them)

text_block_list.text:
Hope Uma Musume in my care uses full potential
to make dream come true.
Shines brightly enough others chase after
her...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
[——How to become "7 G1 winner"...
is it? Quite interesting question.]

Looked up... Monthly Twinkle,
recurring talk show broadcast,
airing on bookstore monitor.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf-san,
with 7 G1 wins——plenty reached milestone,
none surpassed it.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
For many,
faraway dream.
Want to know:
how can one surpass 7 G1 victories?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...That is question,
is it not? Though achieved 7 crowns,
unable to break past that. At loss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However——when Uma Musume capable appears,
surely all eyes focus on her.
choice_data_list: (……7 G1 wins. That's quite the topic)
(……7 G1 wins. That's quite the topic)

text_block_list.text:
Winning just one G1 incredible achievement
alone.
Symboli Rudolf and others with 7 G1 wins
already longest of long shots.
choice_data_list: (Will someone really be able to to...
(Will someone really be able to to...

text_block_list.text: With lingering thoughts, headed home...

Near riverside,
butterfly fluttered weakly.

Worried,
tried following.
Walked along bank looking around. Then——
Fuu...!

Strong wind blew.
Lone Uma Musume ran under overpass.
Haa, haa, haa, haa! ...Not yet! Haaaaaaa!

Form allowed wide range of motion.
Kicked ground,
accelerating in blink of eye.
Eyes focused ahead, shining brightly.

Haaa,
phew... ...? Good afternoon! That badge...
Tracen Academy trainer?
choice_data_list: Ah……Yeah! I'm a trainer, what abou...
Ah……Yeah! I'm a trainer, what abou...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm Almond Eye! Tracen Academy Uma Musume.
Heheh.

Lively Uma Musume with lots of potential.
First impression of Almond Eye.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three, four. Two, two, three,
four. ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Instructor! Almond Eye, departing!

Since then,
often saw her on training grounds. Earnest,
listened to instructor.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa,
haa! Phew. ...Almost dinner time? ...Alright,
one more!

Occasionally in evening,
saw her doing self-training on grounds.

Talented, hard-working,
『Honor Student Uma Musume』.
That was thought. At least at first——
